title: prefill/decode pipeline: chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage overlap
author: Alex Kim
description: Motivation: Prefill (key/value cache population) and decode stages frequently sit idle waiting on each other for large-batch and mixed-request workloads. This PR implements three complementary optimizations: 1) chunked prefill: split long prefill sequences into adjustable chunks to expose parallelism and avoid long-tail latency; 2) speculative prefill: when decode requests target a small prefix of a new sequence, start a speculative, low-priority prefill for the remaining context to warm KV caches ahead of decode; 3) stage overlap: schedule prefill and decode stages in the pipeline to overlap where safe, with precise KV-cache synchronization points to avoid stale reads. Summary: introduces a new chunking scheduler, a speculative prefill execution path guarded by a runtime feature-flag, and fine-grained barriers between prefill/decode kernels. Benchmarks: on our perf-canary with Llama-like models and real request traces, median latency for mixed prefill+decode requests improved by 18-27% depending on distribution; 95th percentile improved by 12-20%; aggregate token throughput increased by ~15% under steady-state traffic. Changes include kernel-side adjustments to KV eviction and rewrite semantics to support chunked inserts without full lock contention, and scheduler updates to prioritize short decode requests while permitting background speculative prefill. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless the feature-flag "prefill.pipeline_overlap" or "prefill.speculative" is enabled; these are off for Dedicated/Private GA rollout until further validation. Testing: unit tests for KV cache invariants, integration tests for pipeline correctness, perf harness added to measure chunk size impact. Rollout plan: merge behind feature-flag, enable for perf-canary only for 48h, monitor cache hit-rate and latency regressions, then gradual rollout to hosted API 5%/25%/100% over two weeks. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4121) [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] perf bench added [x] feature flags gated [x] docs updated.
commits: feat(prefill): add chunked prefill scheduler with configurable chunk_size and inter-chunk gap
perf(prefill): speculative prefill path that launches background KV population for predicted tails
sched: allow prefill/decode stage overlap with barrier points and lightweight sync primitives
kv: introduce chunked-kv-insert APIs and atomic sequence tag to prevent double-writes
kernels: minor changes to CUDA memory copy ordering to reduce stalls when overlapping stages
tests(perf): add prefill-decode pipeline benchmark and ci harness integration
docs: document feature flags and rollout guidance
ci_checks: integration-tests: fail (flaky on first run) -> rerun -> pass
review_comments: Maya Patel (2024-10-13): Nice end-to-end. Please add microbench results isolating KV insert latency for chunk sizes [64,128,256]. Also ensure chunked-kv insert is lock-free on the hot path.

Alex Kim (2024-10-14): Added microbench harness and documented results in benchmarks/pipeline_latency.yaml. chunked_kv uses per-shard metadata with atomics; path is lock-free for inserts where shard ownership is known.

Ethan Liu (2024-10-15): Concern about speculative prefill causing unnecessary memory pressure under high-concurrency. Recommend adding a configurable budget and backpressure signal from eviction metrics.

Alex Kim (2024-10-15): Added budget setting prefill.speculative.memory_budget and backpressure hook to kv_cache eviction metrics. Default budget is conservative (5% of model KV capacity) and off for dedicated/private by default.
Samira Gomez (2024-10-18): Please add a safety test ensuring that overlapping stages do not read stale KV entries when a prefill chunk is aborted mid-insert.
Alex Kim (2024-10-19): Added abort path test and ensured chunk inserts are tagged with monotonically-increasing sequence ids so decodes with older sequence ids are rejected until commit.
Maya Patel (2024-10-22): LGTM after one nit on comment clarity. Approving.
Ethan Liu (2024-10-23): Approved. Noted perf-canary will be required before wide rollout.
release_notes: Adds chunked and speculative prefill paths and optional stage overlap to reduce prefill+decode tail latency and increase throughput. Gated by runtime feature flags 'prefill.pipeline_overlap' and 'prefill.speculative'. Default off for Dedicated/Private. Config knobs: prefill.chunk_size, prefill.speculative.memory_budget, prefill.pipeline_overlap.enabled. See docs/perf/prefill_decode.md for tuning guidance.
